hook: Who are you? Which device? When did it start? The same questions, on every call.
intro: Here is how Mova iO creates complete tickets in ServiceNow, from any channel, without the twenty questions.
s1: Neha is working from home, and her V P N keeps dropping. She tells the I T help agent in Teams, in her own words.
s2: The agent already knows who she is and which laptop she uses, from Entra and Intune. It asks just one question, and pulls the V P N logs from her laptop in the background.
s3: Seconds later, the incident exists in ServiceNow. Caller, device, category, impact, a clean short description, and a summary of the chat, all filled in. The logs are attached.
s4: The same works for email. A message to the service desk about a jammed printer becomes a ticket, and because the printer already has an open incident, it is linked instead of duplicated.
s5: And voice: a voicemail is transcribed and turned into a ticket. In the queue, every new ticket arrives complete, whatever the channel.
s6: Neha gets her ticket number in Teams with a fix to try now, and she never had to fill in a form.
close: Tickets created in seconds, from chat, email and voice. Every field filled in. Duplicates linked, not logged twice.
tag: Ticket creation, handled by Mova iO agents. With people in control.
end: Movate. Your applied A I partner.
